audit.why: Gangplank owns levels 1-5 outright but loses the scaling race; that is an even lane, not a favoured one, and the 4/10 badge tells the player to relax in a lane he must close early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts had Kayle winning Level 3 and Levels 4-5 and Gangplank winning Level 6 — the exact inverse of the packet chart and of the page's own text, which calls her 'one of the most helpless level-1 to level-5 laners in the game'.
audit.why: A melee, waveclear-less Kayle does not win levels 3-5 against Parrrley. Level 6 is where Divine Judgment makes the all-in a coin flip, which is the 'Skill' stage.
audit.corrected: win[1..4] and phases[1..4].side flipped to Gangplank/Gangplank/Gangplank/Skill with matching ratings, as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it: the page never names Radiant Blast, Celestial Blessing or Starfire Spellblade, and gives no cooldown numbers for Divine Judgment.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a 15-second heal that decides every extended trade and is the reason anti-heal is core here. Starfire Spellblade is an auto-attack reset, so her burst opens on an auto wind-up, not a visible cast. Radiant Blast is 900 range and shreds resistances on a 12s cooldown at rank 1 — the step-up window is right after it. Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s of invulnerability, long enough that baiting it wins the lane.
